lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, with the highest-intensity local maxima arranged in a semi-regular grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary spot rows to form visible grid-like anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges on the upper flank showing a sharp luminance gradient with a bright superior edge and a shadowed inferior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch and localized darkening indicative of tissue loss on the posterior-superior margin of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High concentration of minute, high-intensity spots along the leading edge of the pectoral fin compared to the lower density on the fin's central surface.
